section: 6.6 — SHAP Artifact Persistence and Dashboard Handoff
purpose: Describe the persisted SHAP explanations and their use in frontend integration.

interpretation_guidance.global_importance: Mean absolute SHAP values summarize feature importance across the sampled Validation observations and output classes.
interpretation_guidance.class_wise_importance: Class-wise mean absolute SHAP values describe the relative importance of each feature for each output class.
interpretation_guidance.dependence_analysis: Dependence records pair a feature value in model-input representation with its SHAP contribution to the selected class output.
interpretation_guidance.local_explanations: Local contribution records describe feature contributions for selected individual Validation observations.
interpretation_guidance.plain_english_generation: Not generated in N06. The frontend can convert structured SHAP records into user-facing explanatory text.
limitations: SHAP contributions explain model behavior and are not causal effects.
The Independent Test partition was not accessed.
The original class distribution was not rebalanced for SHAP sampling.
